name: Biology Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course through university biology: from molecules and cells to genetics, microbes, plants and animals, neuroscience, evolution, ecology and quantitative biology.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大学生物学课程：从分子与细胞，到遗传学、微生物、植物与动物、神经科学、进化、生态学与定量生物学。
lede: A detailed, interactive course through university biology — from molecules and cells to genetics and genomics, microbes, plants and animals, the brain and behaviour, evolution, ecology and the quantitative tools of modern biology. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大学生物学课程——从分子与细胞，到遗传学与基因组学、微生物、植物与动物、脑与行为、进化、生态学以及现代生物学的定量工具。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive tour of the undergraduate biology curriculum, written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大学本科生物学课程导览，可配合课堂和教材阅读。
about_lede: Biology Atlas is a free, detailed tour of the biology taught in a university degree — written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 生物学图谱是一套免费、详尽的大学生物学导览——可以配合课堂和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From the first microscopes to the double helix and genome sequencing: the discoveries behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从最早的显微镜到DNA双螺旋和基因组测序：图谱中每门课程背后的发现。
timeline_lede: The discoveries behind the courses, from Hooke’s cells and Darwin’s natural selection to the double helix, the genetic code and genome sequencing. Coloured dots show the area of biology; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的发现：从胡克的细胞和达尔文的自然选择，到DNA双螺旋、遗传密码和基因组测序。彩色圆点表示所属生物学领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: University biology: molecules and cells, genetics and genomics, microbes, plants and animals, neuroscience and behaviour, evolution, ecology and conservation, and quantitative biology. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 大学生物学：分子与细胞、遗传与基因组、微生物、植物与动物、神经科学与行为、进化、生态与保护以及定量生物学。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

areas.label: Molecules & cells
areas.blurb: The chemistry of life, the cell and how genes are expressed.
areas.blurb_zh: 生命的化学、细胞以及基因如何表达。

areas.label: Genetics & genomics
areas.blurb: Inheritance, genomes and variation in populations.
areas.blurb_zh: 遗传、基因组以及群体中的变异。

areas.label: Organisms
areas.blurb: How microbes, plants and animals live, grow and develop.
areas.blurb_zh: 微生物、植物和动物如何生活、生长与发育。

areas.label: Brain & behaviour
areas.blurb: Nervous systems, from single neurons to behaviour.
areas.blurb_zh: 神经系统：从单个神经元到行为。

areas.label: Evolution & diversity
areas.blurb: The history and diversity of life, and the processes that produce it.
areas.blurb_zh: 生命的历史与多样性，以及产生它们的过程。

areas.label: Ecology & environment
areas.blurb: Populations, communities, ecosystems and their conservation.
areas.blurb_zh: 种群、群落、生态系统及其保护。

areas.label: Quantitative biology
areas.blurb: Statistics, computation and mathematical models for biology.
areas.blurb_zh: 面向生物学的统计、计算与数学模型。
